class.name: BulletWobbleData2D
class.brief_description: Sine/cosine flight modulation for danmaku snakes, weaves, and petals.
class.description: Attach as [member DirectionalBulletsData2D.shared_bullet_wobble_data] (one resource fans out per bullet via [member phase_step_per_bullet]) or per bullet via [member DirectionalBulletsData2D.all_bullet_wobble_data]. Lateral mode weaves perpendicular to flight; Angular mode oscillates the heading. Set [member enabled] to true, otherwise the entry is skipped. Pick the shape with [member waveform]: Sine starts at zero offset (smooth weave away from center), Cosine starts at full offset (bullets fan out immediately) — both work in either mode and combine freely with homing, curves, rotation, speed, gravity, and drag.

members.member: Master switch for this entry. Disabled entries are skipped per bullet.
0 = Lateral (weave perpendicular to flight), 1 = Angular (oscillate heading in degrees).

Wave shape evaluated in the wobble tick: 0 = Sine (sin, starts at zero offset), 1 = Cosine (cos, starts at full offset, equal to Sine with a quarter-period phase shift). Applies to both modes and stacks with the delay/duration/damping envelope, distance_phased timing, and per-bullet phase fan-out.
Wobble size in pixels (Lateral) or degrees (Angular). Must be finite and >= 0.
Oscillations per second. Must be finite and >= 0.

Base phase in radians. Each bullet adds [member phase_step_per_bullet] times its index. Tip: Cosine with phase 0 behaves like Sine with phase PI/2, so switching [member waveform] is the easy way to get that quarter-period shift without doing the math.
Per-bullet phase fan-out. One shared resource with a non-zero step makes snakes and petals instead of synced waves.
Phase from distance traveled instead of time, so speed changes do not warp the shape.
Exponential decay of the wobble over time. 0 = undamped.
Seconds of straight flight before wobble starts.
Seconds of wobble before it stops. 0 = infinite.
